<think>**Implementing balanced nibble reductions**

**Generating mask assignments**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module axis_eth_fcs_reset (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] s_axis_tdata,
    input wire s_axis_tkeep,
    input wire s_axis_tvalid,
    output wire s_axis_tready,
    input wire s_axis_tlast,
    input wire s_axis_tuser,
    output wire [31:0] output_fcs,
    output wire output_fcs_valid
);
    reg [31:0] crc_state;
    reg [31:0] fcs_reg;
    reg fcs_valid_reg;
    wire [31:0] crc_next;
    wire [7:0] q;

    // Factor each data/state pair before the parallel CRC matrix.
    assign q = crc_state[7:0] ^ s_axis_tdata;

    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer n;
        begin
            case (n)
                0: crc_mask = 8'h04;
                1: crc_mask = 8'h09;
                2: crc_mask = 8'h13;
                3: crc_mask = 8'h26;
                4: crc_mask = 8'h4d;
                5: crc_mask = 8'h9a;
                6: crc_mask = 8'h30;
                7: crc_mask = 8'h61;
                8: crc_mask = 8'hc2;
                9: crc_mask = 8'h80;
                10: crc_mask = 8'h04;
                11: crc_mask = 8'h08;
                12: crc_mask = 8'h11;
                13: crc_mask = 8'h23;
                14: crc_mask = 8'h46;
                15: crc_mask = 8'h8c;
                16: crc_mask = 8'h1d;
                17: crc_mask = 8'h3b;
                18: crc_mask = 8'h77;
                19: crc_mask = 8'hee;
                20: crc_mask = 8'hd8;
                21: crc_mask = 8'hb4;
                22: crc_mask = 8'h6c;
                23: crc_mask = 8'hd8;
                24: crc_mask = 8'hb5;
                25: crc_mask = 8'h6f;
                26: crc_mask = 8'hdf;
                27: crc_mask = 8'hba;
                28: crc_mask = 8'h71;
                29: crc_mask = 8'he3;
                30: crc_mask = 8'hc3;
                31: crc_mask = 8'h82;
                default: crc_mask = 8'h00;
            endcase
        end
    endfunction

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin : crc_matrix
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(k);
            wire [7:0] terms;
            wire [3:0] pair_xor;
            wire parity;
            assign terms = q & MASK;
            assign pair_xor = {terms[7] ^ terms[6],
                               terms[5] ^ terms[4],
                               terms[3] ^ terms[2],
                               terms[1] ^ terms[0]};
            assign parity = (pair_xor[0] ^ pair_xor[1]) ^
                            (pair_xor[2] ^ pair_xor[3]);
            if (k < 24) begin : shifted_state
                assign crc_next[k] = parity ^ crc_state[k+8];
            end else begin : feedback_only
                assign crc_next[k] = parity;
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    // Mutually exclusive controls put reset/enable decoding in parallel
    // with the CRC network instead of cascading data multiplexers.
    wire crc_hold;
    wire crc_advance;
    wire crc_clear;
    wire fcs_load;
    wire fcs_hold;
    assign crc_hold = !rst && !s_axis_tvalid;
    assign crc_advance = !rst && s_axis_tvalid && !s_axis_tlast;
    assign crc_clear = rst || (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast);
    assign fcs_load = !rst && s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast;
    assign fcs_hold = !rst && !(s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        crc_state <= ({32{crc_hold}} & crc_state) |
                     ({32{crc_advance}} & crc_next) |
                     {32{crc_clear}};
        fcs_reg <= ({32{fcs_hold}} & fcs_reg) |
                   ({32{fcs_load}} & ~crc_next);
        fcs_valid_reg <= fcs_load;
    end

    assign s_axis_tready = 1'b1;
    assign output_fcs = fcs_reg;
    assign output_fcs_valid = fcs_valid_reg;
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference CRC expressions contain long serial XOR chains combining low CRC bits, upper CRC bits and input data, followed by register hold/reset selection. These paths are likely setup bottlenecks in the CRC feedback and FCS capture cones.",
  "rewrite": "Factor the eight shared data XOR low-state terms, implement the exact reference CRC matrix using balanced parity trees, and combine mutually exclusive hold, advance and reset terms with parallel AND/OR selection. Preserve crc_state, fcs_reg and fcs_valid_reg names and encodings.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement comes from reducing CRC parity depth and avoiding cascaded reset/enable multiplexers after the CRC network. The largest masks require at most three parity levels after the shared input XOR, plus the upper-state XOR where applicable. Actual WNS improvement requires mapped STA; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Retains the original 65 register bits and adds no latency or storage. Shared input XORs and constant-folded parity trees should limit combinational area; parallel control gating may change cell count and control fanout. Compliance with the 5033.202240 um2 cap and electrical constraints requires implementation checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves synchronous reset priority, all-ones CRC reset and end-of-frame restart, zero FCS reset, FCS hold between captures, and one-cycle registered valid behavior. Every valid byte participates regardless of tkeep or tuser, matching the reference. Ready remains permanently asserted. No initial values, startup assumptions, extra cycles, undefined outputs or helper modules are used."
}
